records.title: Задний навес отдельно
records.subject: A freestanding REAR CANOPY MODULE ONLY for a modular travelling merchant stall, all its parts visibly connected. Show the complete two posts down to their bottoms, top beam and broad painted canvas folds. No counter, no goods, no ground, no lanterns. No flags, no loose hanging cloth crossing future merchandise.
